notes: Generate a contact sheet of five numbered options first.
After the creator chooses one option, generate that option again as a standalone 1024x1024 icon.
Do not bake rounded corners into the final app icon; iOS applies the mask.

safetyChecklist: No official logos, crests, event marks, product shapes, characters, celebrity likenesses, player photos, or copyrighted artwork unless the creator provides authorization.
Avoid confusingly similar generated artwork when the app references a real event, brand, organization, league, team, venue, or media property.
Prefer original generic motifs, abstract marks, colors, and domain-relevant objects that are not protected source identifiers.
Inspect the selected icon at small sizes before shipping and update App Review notes if replacing IP-sensitive art after rejection.

optionPrompts.name: premium-realistic-hero-object
optionPrompts.direction: A polished premium icon with one large generic domain object centered, surrounded by smaller generic background objects and dramatic lighting.

optionPrompts.name: minimal-bold-symbol
optionPrompts.direction: A simple high-contrast abstract symbol or monogram on a strong solid or subtly textured background, readable at tiny sizes.

optionPrompts.name: environment-energy
optionPrompts.direction: An atmospheric icon built from lights, motion, particles, or stage/stadium energy, with a clear original focal shape.

optionPrompts.name: collector-premium
optionPrompts.direction: A foil, holographic, trading-card, or collectible-inspired treatment with original geometry and no third-party marks.

optionPrompts.name: friendly-utility
optionPrompts.direction: A bright, approachable utility-style icon using rounded original shapes, clear contrast, and a practical app-tool feeling.
